caption: The drawing depicts a single metal object that appears to be a branding iron, oriented horizontally across the upper half of the image. The object has a circular handle on the left side, attached to a straight, elongated shaft that bends near the right end, where it connects to a square-shaped, hollow head. The branding head is rendered with brownish, rust-like shades, suggesting a worn, metallic texture. Below the branding iron, there is a brown rhombus or diamond shape, representing the imprint or mark created by the square end of the iron. The background is plain and off-white, and there is a small printed name, "Elizabeth Johnson," in the lower right quadrant of the image. The composition is simple, with the objects centrally focused and ample negative space.
title: Branding Iron
